correctness.rationale: Formal Dirichlet convolution identity from κ0 recursion gives ζ/(2−ζ). Labelled-cofactor coefficient extraction gives G_r(t)=2^r e^t/(2−e^t)^{r+1}; with u=e^t−1, 2^-r κ0(N)=Σ_{j=0}^k [binom(r+j,j)+binom(r+j−1,j−1)]j!S(k,j). For k=0,1 this equals 1 and r+2. For k≥2 and odd r, j=1 term r+2 is odd, others even; for even r, j≥3 vanish mod4, and j=1,2 sum ≡2 mod4 because S(k,2)=2^{k−1}−1 odd. Thus the claimed four-case v2 formula for all r≥1 k≥0. Independently recomputed κ0 from proper-divisor exponent-vector recurrence for r=1..14,k=0..7 (112 integer cases); tests corroborate but do not prove unbounded r,k.
